scopeGaps: No versioned NERDC, NECO, BECE or full IGCSE subject syllabuses exist in this checkout. Database-held or tenant-defined specifications were not accessed. Do not invent class-subject cross-products.
JAMB appears in question data but is absent from EXAM_CATALOG; BECE is in the app catalogue but has no stored question batch. Application behaviour has not been changed.
WAEC/JAMB supplied compilations list 37 subject labels, with only 33/25 collected respectively. These indexes are candidate scope, not definitive examination subject catalogues.
WAEC official catalogue distinguishes new 2028 core subjects. Historical labels and trade subjects require examination-year reconciliation before targets become final.
NERDC supports 16 application class labels; many existing drafts say only Nursery, Primary, JSS or SS. Exact class, adopted curriculum version, term and objectives require source evidence.
NCEE official 2026 components include National Values Education and vocational aptitude. Existing Basic Science, Quantitative Reasoning and Verbal Reasoning labels need component mapping.
IGCSE requires qualification code, examination year, tier and assessment objectives. Four observed subject names do not establish the entire intended Cambridge portfolio.
IELTS Reading/Writing require Academic versus General Training variants. Listening/Speaking need original audio assets and performance rubrics; MCQ writing advice is not a writing task.
TOEFL must follow the post-21-January-2026 task structure; legacy writing MCQs are not production tasks. SAT has two sections, not historical SAT Subject Tests.

Objective register covers selected English, Economics, science, NCEE, SAT and language-production objectives only, with paraphrased author proposals. It is not a full syllabus denominator. No coverage percentages or completed banks claimed.
Runtime verbal/quantitative generators and Flutter worksheet engines are separate assets, not independently reviewed original exam questions. Their generated counts are excluded.
All targets are provisional until scope, originality, format variety and age-appropriate curriculum capacity are academically justified. No bank has independent academic sign-off.

Biology 0610 v3 and Chemistry 0620 v2 official 2026–2028 sources have been retrieved. Selected topics are mapped; complete objective transcription and independent alignment review remain pending. Physics 0625 and Economics 0455 official PDF downloads timed out; do not treat their syllabus contents as retrieved.

NECO BECE 2026 timetable now establishes 18 subject/route entries and observed objective, essay, practical and drawing formats. Full content objectives and state-exam variants remain unresolved; no BECE questions added from the timetable alone.

New NERDC Primary 1 and JSS 1 class links returned 403. Older public mathematics and English introduction PDFs were found; current adoption is not verified, so no current class-objective coverage is inferred.

Literature batch 035 covers original general-knowledge and unseen-appreciation MCQs only. WAEC official 2026–2030 prescribed-work list is now retrieved (21 works), with an unstarted text coverage inventory. Editions, text-specific objectives, WAEC essays, Shakespeare contexts and current JAMB set-text adoption remain unresolved. Original scenes and poems are not extracts from prescribed authors.

NECO SSCE Internal 2026 timetable verifies formats for twelve existing subject banks. The separate NECO syllabus remains unverified. The timetable neither supplies topic objectives nor establishes SSCE External scope.
